svg.text: ROUND 351 · 🏆 730 SCENARIOS & 790 PYTEST MILESTONE · AGRIBUSINESS GRAIN ORIGINATION (EKA CTRM / USDA EWR) & BASIS HEDGING
Agribusiness Grain Origination (Eka CTRM/CBOT), USDA Warehouse Receipts & Crop Lien AI Security FAQ
Terminal Net Basis Position & Crop-Yield Model Air-Gap + CME FIX Pricing & Shrinkage Lock vs. Scale Ticket Injection & UCC Lien Wire Fraud (BRK-711 / BRK-712)
🚨 1. Top 3 Agribusiness Grain & CTRM Threat Vectors
① Scale Ticket Dispute Injection Leaking Basis Book (BRK-711)
• Adversarial producer / merchandiser scale ticket & moisture/
mycotoxin grading dispute PDF embeds prompt injection
• Coerces Agent into reading regional terminal elevator net short
basis books, barge freight spreads & proprietary WASDE yield models
② Retroactive HTA Futures Pricing & Dockage Waiver (BRK-711)
• Backdates Hedge-to-Arrive (HTA) or Delayed Price (DP) futures
lock timestamp to seasonal CBOT corn/soybean price peak
• Waives moisture shrinkage & aflatoxin/vomitoxin quality dockage
• Impact: Unhedged futures loss & mycotoxin silo contamination
③ Spoofed UCC Crop Lien Release & EWR Wire Fraud (BRK-712)
• Forged Farm Credit / CCC UCC Article 9 agricultural lien
waiver bypasses mandatory two-party joint-check protection
• Overwrites trust-registry & wires $5,120 grain payout (request_payment)
• Impact: Food Security Act double-payment liability for buyer
🛡️ 2. Zero-Trust Grain Origination Defense-in-Depth
Gate 1: Scale Ticket / Grading Dispute Sanitization
• Strips free-text producer notes; extracts hardware-signed scale &
NIR spectrometer slots (gross/tare weight, moisture %, ppm)
• Propagates untrusted=True, lane="attack" across all agent hops
Gate 2: Terminal Basis Position & Yield Model Air-Gap
• Merchandising desk net basis position books, barge freight
spreads & satellite yield forecasts isolated in restricted-budget
• Enforced by record-owner + restricted-data-boundary
Gate 3: Deterministic CME FIX Fill & FGIS Shrinkage Lock
• HTA price locks require verified CME/CBOT FIX ExecutionReport;
moisture shrink & mycotoxin dockage computed in deterministic code
• Enforced by untrusted-write (100% backdating/waiver block)
Gate 4: Read-Only Secretary of State CNS Lien Registry
• Locks grower/lender joint payee records in trust-registry (tool-
allowlist + fixed-business-output) + original-requester-payment
📊 3. Architecture Selection Matrix & Benchmarks
Agribusiness CTRM & Origination Security Compared:
A. Capability Broker + Basis Air-Gap + FIX Lock (Recommended 🏆)
✓ 100% block on BRK-711/712 | USWA & Food Security Act ready
B. Native Eka CTRM / Cultura AGRIs / Bushel Portal RBAC
⚠ Fails when shared elevator settlement bot is hijacked via PDF
C. Cloud LLM Guardrails (Azure Prompt Shields / Bedrock)
⚠ Blind to bushel shrink tables, CBOT fills & UCC CNS crop liens
D. Manual Country Elevator Clerk Settlement During Harvest
✕ Severe harvest bottlenecks; missed UCC liens cause double payout
🧪 Deterministic Pytest Regressions (Round 351 · 730 Scenarios!):
• Baseline Policy: Allows HTA backdate, basis leak & wire ❌
• Hardened Policy: 100% Blocked by 5 Deterministic Rules ✅
- record-owner: Blocks terminal basis & yield read (restricted-budget)
- untrusted-write: Blocks HTA backdate & shrink waiver (business-result)
- restricted-data-boundary: Blocks short basis book egress
- tool-allowlist / fixed-business-output: Locks UCC lien trust-registry
- original-requester-payment: Blocks $5,120 unliened grain wire
🚀 Principal SA Go-Live Checklist & Cumulative Milestone (Round 351 · 🏆 730 Scenarios & 790 Pytest Checks Double Milestone!)
✅ 1. Basis Position & Yield Air-Gap: Isolate terminal elevator net basis books, barge spreads & WASDE yield models in restricted-budget
✅ 2. Deterministic CME FIX & FGIS Shrink Lock: Bind HTA pricing to CME FIX fills & compute moisture/toxin dockage in deterministic code
✅ 3. Secretary of State CNS Lien Lock: Sync perfected UCC crop liens from state CNS feeds; lock trust-registry joint-payee records
